defective_pattern: Creating .stale copies of validation_report.json without physically deleting or unlinking the original file, leaving the legacy state on disk.
why_defective: Leaving the original validation_report.json on disk triggers recursive validation gates to re-evaluate legacy failures, causing pipeline blockers despite the intent to archive the report.
observed_symptoms: Validation gates repeatedly failing on old reports
Existence of both validation_report.json and validation_report.stale.json with identical contents
Pipeline stalled due to ghost validation artifacts
corrective_remedy: Always physically unlink (delete) or move the original validation_report.json when renaming or archiving to a .stale copy. Use explicit shutil.move or os.rename instead of copy.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching the use of shutil.copy on validation reports without a subsequent os.remove
